answer: Batteries are hazardous waste. Store them separately and drop them at an e-waste or hazardous-waste collection point.
A clean pizza box can be recycled, but oily or food-stained parts should go to wet or mixed waste. Tear off clean cardboard for the blue bin.
Rinse milk packets, let them dry, and place them with dry recyclable waste. Tetra packs may need a dedicated recycling stream in some cities.
Plastic bottles usually go in the blue recycling bin. Empty and rinse them first to avoid contamination.
Food scraps and peels are best composted or placed in the green wet-waste bin.
